title: data.pdf — section 122
text:
(3) For the purpose of any proceedings before a tribunal in Scotland, the tribunal may
administer oaths and the Court of Session shall on the application of any party to
the proceedings have the like power as in any action in that court to grant warrant
for the citation of witnesses and havers to give evidence or to produce documents
before the tribunal.

6 Subject to the foregoing provisions of this Schedule, a tribunal may regulate its
own procedure.
